rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something causes an effect, reaction, or situation.

example.english: This accident can engender public panic.
example.traditional: 呢次意外可以引起公眾恐慌。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 ho2 ji5 jan5 hei2 gung1 zung3 hung2 fong1

rows.note: Use this for producing an abstract result or for something coming into existence.

example.english: This decision may engender a series of problems.
example.traditional: 呢個決定可能產生一連串問題。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 caan2 sang1 jat1 lin4 cyun3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when giving existence to living things, especially when giving birth or having offspring.

example.english: This pair of rabbits can engender many offspring.
example.traditional: 呢對兔仔可以生好多仔。
example.jyutping: ne1 deoi3 tou3 zai2 ho2 ji5 saang1 hou2 do1 zai2
